title: Browser network mediation
objective: Implement governed navigation for the isolated Deskal browser host without exposing a generic proxy: public HTTPS only with DNS resolution and re-resolution, DNS rebinding denial, redirect widening denial with hop-by-hop revalidation, downgrade denial, loop and limit enforcement, loopback, link-local, private-network, and metadata-endpoint denial where policy requires, unsafe-scheme denial including file, javascript, browser-internal URLs, and external protocol handlers, and mediated iframe, popup, worker, service-worker, XHR/fetch, WebSocket, QUIC, DoH, WebRTC, download-trigger, and permission behavior. The browser never becomes a generic proxy.

include: governed navigation policy for the isolated host: public HTTPS, DNS resolution and re-resolution, rebinding denial
redirect widening denial with hop-by-hop revalidation, downgrade denial, loop detection, redirect limits
loopback, link-local, and private-network denial where policy requires, cloud metadata endpoint denial
unsafe-scheme denial: file, javascript, browser-internal URLs, external protocol handlers
XHR/fetch, WebSocket, QUIC, DoH, and WebRTC bypass denial
download-trigger mediation and browser permission mediation
proof that the host cannot become a generic proxy
exclude: downloads, uploads, or transfers beyond trigger mediation
new MCP tools, profiles, or remote authority
arbitrary browser JavaScript or generic CDP

authority_delta.process: None beyond the SG-000074 Deskal-supervised low-authority browser child process family.
authority_delta.network: Governed navigation decisions only for the isolated host; no generic socket, proxy, tunnel, or egress authority.
authority_delta.browser: Governed navigation policy only. DOM, actuation, transfers, capture, and input remain unexposed until later grains qualify them shape by shape.
authority_delta.secrets: None. No credential or session material enters records, logs, or evidence.
authority_delta.approval: None. Navigation remains subject to existing approval boundaries where applicable.

invariants: the host never becomes a generic proxy
private, loopback, and metadata targets stay unreachable
unsafe schemes never navigate or execute

acceptance.claim: Governed navigation enforces public HTTPS, DNS re-resolution, rebinding denial, redirect widening denial, downgrade denial, loop and limit enforcement, and private and metadata denial, proven by adversarial tests.

Unsafe schemes, external handlers, iframe and popup escape, worker and service-worker escape, XHR/fetch, WebSocket, QUIC, DoH, WebRTC bypass, download triggers, and permission prompts are denied or mediated with no proxy widening.
Exact-head CI, genuine TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, manual review of excluded files, and zero unresolved review threads all pass.

successor_requirements.sg_000076: SG-000076 may activate only after SG-000075 closes canonically with governed navigation as its base.

done_when: Governed navigation exists for the isolated host with no generic proxy capability, proven by adversarial tests.
